findings.reason: as written the class-reading rule contradicts the measured post-hoc route it is replacing and would fail the plan's own recorded classification on the frames whose margin is absent.
findings.text: the head says the class is read after the solve "from connectivity and the exact margin", but the plan's own route and measurement use connectivity alone: §6's fork decision records "single pinned solve + post-hoc connectivity classification", the co-reachability section classifies all 16 converged 22086/43 terminals DIVERTED "by their own flood-filled connectivity", and §5 itself records that a non-finite margin makes the class "explicitly unclassified" while §4 states the margin is "undefined on two of six production references" (one being 22086/43) — so a builder implementing the head's instrument returns unclassified on the very frame the plan records as 16/16 DIVERTED

findings.reason: a builder reading the head will not keep the smooth weight as the selection observable against `class_margin`, which is the role the locked decision and the landed record both assign it.
findings.text: the head now says the smooth weight "stays available as a differentiable class indicator for consumers that need gradients; it selects between no branches", while the same section's landed record at :479 says "p_diverted alone carries the smooth blend and has nonzero gradients", §4's consequence paragraph reasons that "an observable that is absent on a third of the cohort cannot carry selection; one that is defined everywhere ... can", and the lead's 2026-10-01 lock of `selection-observable` is both-explicit-roles ("the smooth weight carries selection and gradients") — the head therefore revokes the selection role of an observable the plan locks as the selection carrier without recording that decision as superseded
